craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 19. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: At the twelve-end, then, having performed, in the bindu-pair he should
cast: in the unmarked or supreme abode, joined to the Supreme Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dvādaśānte tataḥ kṛtvā binduyugmagate kṣipet nirlakṣye vā pare dhāmni saṃyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ
